item.name: Returns pickup locations nearest to the provided address.

request.name: Returns pickup locations nearest to the provided address.

description.content:
Request example:
```
curl -X GET "https://api-sandbox.postnl.nl/shipment/v2_1/locations/nearest?CountryCode=NL&PostalCode=2132WT&City=Hoofddorp&Street=Siriusdreef&HouseNumber=42&HouseNumberExtension=-60&DeliveryDate=24-12-2022&OpeningTime=09%3A00%3A00" \
 -H "Accept: application/json" \
 -H "apikey: APIKEY-HERE" \
```

query.description: (Required) The country of the recipient's address
(Required) The zipcode of the recipient's address
The city of the recipient's address
The street name of the recipient's address
The house number of the recipient's address
The house number extension of the recipient's address

The date of the earliest delivery date at the pickup location. Format:  dd-MM-yyyy. Note: this date cannot be in the past, otherwise an error is returned. If not provided, the present day is used as a default

Opening time filter. Format: hh:mm:ss. This field will be used to filter out locations that are closed at the time provided. If no opening time is provided all locations will be returned regardless of their opening times.

The pickup location types for which locations should be filtered. By default all location types are returned (PG = Retail points and parcel lockers). This can be used to filter on only parcel lockers (PA) or specifically exclude parcel lockers from the response (PG_EX).

response.name: Locations nearest to the address provided
